\noindent Generated caption: RQ4 alert-shift robustness (H4a). RE2, oracle alert moved by the shift, all sources; $\pm$60 and $\pm$120 s test H4a, $\pm$30 s is exploratory (04 \S{}2). Deterministic arms at every shift, then the brief arm; no shifted brief run has results (Sources), so the brief arm's 0 s point is re2-oracle-rq2-v1 on all cases with its intervals, and no shifted brief point pairs with it. The 0 s point is re2-oracle-rq1-v1, whose verdicts are uncalibrated (split none); the 0 s rows of re2-oracle-rq3-v1 (revised as re2-oracle-rq3-off-v1) are the calibrated unperturbed reference for coverage and set size, since every perturbed run reuses its calibration files (04 \S{}5.4 item 4). 95\% cluster-bootstrap intervals in brackets; a value without one says so (04 \S{}8); failed, timed-out, no-alert, rejected and unranked runs count as misses. Outcomes counts all the group's rows per run outcome (03 \S{}13.3): its fault-case runs and, in an experiment with normal windows, one row per normal window, so it can exceed Fault-case runs. Avg@5, MRR, Fine AC@k and Rerank@1 are listed by these experiments and are in each one's summary.json, but not tabulated here. Protocol of each experiment: see Sources.\par
